label: St John's College MS 151

metadata.label: Description
metadata.value: MS 151 comprises three astronomical texts, including a 1532 copy of Ulugh Beg’s astronomical and chronological tables (zīj) in the revised version.

metadata.label: Contents
metadata.value: (1) Ulugh Beg ibn Shāhrukh ibn Tīmūr Gurgān, [Zīj-i jadīd-i sulṭānī [= [The New Tables of the Sultan]] (fols. 1b-131b); (2) Anonymous Persian (with some Arabic) miscellany on nativities (fols. 132a-148a); (3) Collection of Persian astronomical and calendric tables (fols. 149a-180b).

metadata.label: Record Origin
metadata.value: Emile Savage-Smith, A Descriptive Catalogue of Oriental Manuscripts at St John’s College Oxford (Oxford: Oxford University Press, 2005).

metadata.label: Holding Institution
metadata.value: St John's College, University of Oxford
